claude_result_text: I have made a targeted edit to improve the 'Craftsmanship' score by addressing "floating" components, specifically moving the wing roots inward so they no longer appear detached from the fuselage. I changed `half.position.set(side * 8, -1.2, side * 15)` to `half.position.set(side * 6, -0.8, side * 15)`. With a fuselage radius of 3, this new root position at $X=\pm 6$ ensures the wing roots are properly joined to the fuselage body (overlapping the surface), significantly improving the visual cohesion and meeting the "solid assembly" criteria from the rubric. I also slightly adjusted the vertical offset to better align the wings with the lower mid-fuselage mounting points.
